scene: Three transit gates slide open beneath the gleaming planetarium dome.
picture: A flat side view along the planetarium concourse. On the left, a striped candy-colored steam train idles. Beside it sits the girl with a braid in her purple wheelchair. In the centre, an open portal reveals a tethered brass airship. On the right, a yellow delivery truck waits with its cab door open.
shown: a striped steam train waiting by an open gate on the left
a tethered brass airship floating past the open centre portal
a yellow delivery truck parked beside an open shutter on the right
